name: What are the different types of shower replacements available?

mainEntity.name: What are the different types of shower replacements available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shower replacements typically fall into several categories: pre-fabricated shower units (one-piece or multi-piece inserts), custom tiled showers, or tub-to-shower conversions. Pre-fabricated units offer a quicker installation and are often more budget-friendly. Custom tiled showers provide more design flexibility and a higher-end finish. Tub-to-shower conversions remove an existing bathtub to create a larger, more accessible shower space. The best choice depends on your budget, design preferences, and bathroom layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available shower replacements include pre-fabricated units, custom tiled showers, and tub-to-shower conversions, varying in cost and design.
